en.gameDesc: Drag vertices to untangle the graph so that no edges cross. If the graph is non-planar, declare it! Use Euler's formula (v - e + f = 2) and Kuratowski's theorem to reason about planarity.

af.gameDesc: Sleep hoekpunte om die grafiek te ontwar sodat geen kante kruis nie. As die grafiek nie-planêr is, verklaar dit! Gebruik Euler se formule (v - e + f = 2) en Kuratowski se stelling om oor planariteit te redeneer.

zu.gameDesc: Hudula amaverteksi ukuze uthukulule igrafu ukuze kungabi bikho imiphetho eyonqenayo. Uma igrafu ingekho yi-planar, kumemezele! Sebenzisa iformula ka-Euler (v - e + f = 2) nesithiyo sikaKuratowski ukuze ucabange nge-planarity.
